scope: Early matched mixed IQ1_S/M MI50 screen, 40 calls including warmups. Results are descriptive only, not a final performance gate.
units: PP and TG rates are tokens/second; phase times are seconds.

run.captured_state_note: Captured state is running/pre-cleanup; runner final record says passed and removed. OOMKilled was false in this snapshot.

activity.monitor_limitations: Short-lived processes between samples may be missed; disappeared/new and inaccessible processes are retained as coverage limits. Unavailable GPU counters are not zero.

limitations: PP and TG both reset before execution. P/PP + G/TG sums separate empty-history microbench phases; it is NOT decode after that prompt or request/server latency. Load/startup are excluded.
mx n_ctx=max(512,P,G); llmx reach=max(P,G). Allocated KV layouts need not match. Identical token-stream seeds: PP12345 and TG777. F32 K/V; llmx auto F16 arithmetic; ubatch512; threads4.
Four matched blocks per cell; no measured layout noise band, both-phase floor verdict, or automatic acceptance/rejection.

All warmups and samples retained. Activity flags describe overlapping monitor intervals, not proven causation. Whole-disk counters are not process-attributed. Short-lived processes may escape sampling; unavailable counters are unknown, not zero.
